name: Engaresero waterfall gorge
why: Up a narrow red gorge from the Maasai village of Engaresero, wading the warm stream to a waterfall in a cliff pool.
book: Village fee and a local Maasai guide at Engaresero.
dangers: You walk in the stream: shoes that can get wet.
Flash floods after rain on the escarpment: do not go in a storm.

points.name: Engaresero
points.note: A Maasai village at the foot of the Rift escarpment, near the lake.

points.name: Engaresero Falls
points.note: A waterfall that falls into a pool between red rock walls.
